description: Searches Google Maps for a business by name, or for a kind of business, and lists the places Maps shows. Use it first when the user names a business, to get an exact placeId or cid to pass as business to the other tools; if several candidates fit, ask the user which one. It works in the user's own Chrome through the Local SEO extension, opening Google Maps in a background tab, and fails with a message saying how to connect when the extension is not connected. Nothing is written to Google. Returns query, from (the point searched from, null when Maps chose) and candidates. Each result has position (1-based, ads not counted), sponsored, name, ids (placeId, cid, kgId, featureId, each null when Maps did not expose it), primaryCategory, rating, reviewCount, address and location (the place pin {lat, lng}), each null when the list did not show it.

near.description: Where the search is seen from: {lat, lng}, or a place name such as "West Nyack, NY" that is looked up in Maps. Defaults to Maps' own view, which is usually the user's location.

query.description: The search as a customer types it into Maps, such as "Nyack Plumbing Co".

name: find_business
title: Find a business
